parameters.name: Type
parameters.description:
The type of the service. Valid values:

*   `arms`: ARMS
*   `arms_app`: Application Monitoring
*   `arms_web`: Browser Monitoring
*   `prometheus_monitor`: Managed Service for Prometheus
*   `synthetic_post`: Synthetic Monitoring

example.unifiedCli: aliyun arms open-arms-service-second-version --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --type arms --api-version 2019-08-08 --region cn-hangzhou
